pages.name: The Cats Ruined Everything
pages.description: The woman carries an enormous bag with two cats poking out. The cats are tangled in yarn and yowling. A pet carrier and some kind of milk can stand nearby. The woman asks for help.

pages.name: Exhausting Evening
pages.description: You spend several hours untangling yarn and catching cats. The woman thanks you and gives you a porcelain lantern that you had mistaken for a milk can.

scenePatch.description: The woman is walking with her cats. A pet carrier and a large bag stand nearby.

pages.name: Successful Escape
pages.description: No regrets. A fresh wind strikes your face.
